checks.description: Every track validates against allclear-schema.json (cwi-allclear/v1): required keys present, catalog_ref is a URL, use_type and verdict enums are in-vocabulary, each track carries owner_contact. The 24 seed tracks are unique. Brand rule: the official CWI logo is present on every shipped visual asset (index.html, announce.html) — no page renders without the badge.

Only verified CWI facts ship: 24 track titles copied from the A&R catalog nodes; Zooted Zone ~307K lifetime plays (observed 2026-09-14); New Rap Hits placements #21/#30/#31 (observed 2026-09-15); Diabolique 2026-07-03 at Cue Recording Studios, Arlington VA; commercial/ad uses verdict 'conditional' with contact hp@cumulativeweb.com. No deny-list language anywhere.
DEFAULT_CONFIG + optional config.json override flow works: a config.json with orgName/productName/colors overrides the CWI defaults and produces a branded build with no unreplaced tokens.

EQUIP / CONFIGURE / APPLY steps are copy-paste operable: every URL referenced (reference shape, seed dataset, schema, card, page, compass hub, contact) is live, and the APPLY block is a valid verdict-lookup snippet.

evidence.clearance-schema-conformance: 24/24 seed tracks pass the schema validator in automated gate 1; titles match ~/workspace/cwi-company/nodes/catalog.json
evidence.give-block-operability: give-block.md EQUIP/CONFIGURE/APPLY reference allclear.json, allclear.cwi.json, schema, item-card, page, compass hub, hp@cumulativeweb.com — all live per gate 2
evidence.verified-facts-integrity: gate 1 asserts the 24 titles, the observed metrics strings, the placement strings, and the conditional-on-commercial rule; deny-list scan clean
evidence.white-label-config: gate 4 builds a temp config.json override (orgName/productName/colors) through build.py and confirms the overrides land in index.html with no leftover tokens
